features.text: Patient reports left ankle pain following a fall while walking with his wife.
Patient describes the injury as occurring when he stepped off the curb and landed on his left ankle incorrectly.
Patient states he did not hear a pop but felt the ankle stretch and has been experiencing pain on the outside of the left ankle.
Patient was able to walk on the injured ankle after the incident but it was painful.
Patient reports no substantial prior injuries to the left ankle.
Patient has been taking ibuprofen, elevating, and icing the ankle to manage the pain.
Patient rates his current pain as an 8 on a scale of 0 to 10.
Patient reports that ibuprofen reduces the pain to a 7.
Patient mentions he and his wife have been taking walks frequently, especially during the pandemic.
Patient has not visited the new trails near the Rex Center yet.
Patient agrees to the treatment plan, including using an air cast, crutches, and following the RICE protocol.
